item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 26/Apr/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, it will be windier over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. A trough of low pressure is expected to cross the coast of southern China on the weekend and bring showers and thunderstorms to the region. With the trough of low pressure departing, showers will lessen over the coastal areas early next week. An anticyclone aloft will affect Guangdong midweek next week. The weather will improve and temperatures will rise gradually over the region.
